blind_row_selection_rule.classification: retain every Rhea release-141 reaction mapped independently to an EC identifier whose complete dot-delimited class begins 4.2.1
blind_row_selection_rule.direction: from the complete Rhea direction quartet, inspect only the source side and retain each directed row having exactly two source components, exactly one source water component and at least one explicit reducible multiple-bond token in the other source component
blind_row_selection_rule.outcome_inaccessibility: the target side, target component count, target atom inventory and target adjacency are forbidden to the selector and prediction program
blind_row_selection_rule.ordering: retain qualifying target identities in exact increasing Rhea identifier order without a row limit, random draw, favorable-only filter or major-product selector
postseal_targets: exact heavy-atom occurrence inventory on both sides
source multiple-bond support and target adjacency correspondence
every favorable adverse absent malformed and unresolved qualifying row

native_arithmetic_boundary: No external numerical zero, signed, decimal, continuum or conventional structure inscription enters native forcing; structural absence is EmptyOne.
